binding.commit: Required from a separately approved task; never default to a branch tip
binding.manifest: SHA256 of canonical sorted path/content-SHA256/executable records

integration.result: Existing RepositorySnapshot consumed by candidate_workspace and development host composition
integration.activation: Both enabled=True and owner_authorized=True are required; imports do nothing
integration.issuance: Trusted injected issuer must request exactly repository_ids=[1375052827] and contents/metadata read; validate returned repository scope and expiry before fetch
integration.fetch: Fresh Git object store, one HTTPS fetch of the exact commit, no checkout, submodule, hook, persistent remote or credential helper
integration.credential_transport: Only the fetch child environment carries the authorization header; child environment is allowlisted and cleared afterward
integration.release: Return snapshot only after expected content digest matches, revocation is confirmed and temporary object-store cleanup succeeds
integration.failure: Retain an exclusive receipt directory, redact underlying exception details, stop without retry on uncertain issuance, fetch, revoke or cleanup

remaining_before_live_source_fetch: Review and merge the offline implementation through repository CI
Completed access setup: app 5404433, installation 173585570; key fingerprint verified; using it remains unauthorized
Approve a disk-quota or equivalent storage bound for the temporary Git object store; post-fetch snapshot size limits do not bound download disk use
Pin an actual task commit and independent expected content manifest
Authorize one source fetch separately; app setup alone is not fetch or workflow approval
Linux CI qualification of the composed path; it is offline-tested with fake OpenSSL, Git and HTTPS only
Connect the composition to a trusted host entrypoint under a separate approval

access_proposal.name_check: Exact private app created and installed under factory-bonus-source-access-v1; no tokens requested
access_proposal.visibility: Private; installable only on the owner account
access_proposal.key_generation: One key, one download; no automatic retry
access_proposal.key_access: Inherit and verify only FactoryRunner, Administrators and SYSTEM from C:\FactoryRunner; never broaden ACLs
access_proposal.key_verification: Derive public-key SHA256 fingerprint locally and compare with GitHub; never print or copy private-key contents into chat or repository
access_proposal.key_cleanup: After verified protected storage, delete only the exact temporary download copy; retain the protected key for future separately authorized issuance
access_proposal.revocation: If setup is uncertain, stop and report app/installation/key identifiers without retries. Owner can suspend or uninstall this selected-repository app to remove repository access. Do not assume the sole key can be deleted without GitHub-specific prerequisites.
access_proposal.cost: Existing no-cost access only; stop before any paid feature or upgrade
access_proposal.maximum_mutations: One app registration, one selected-repository installation, one key generation/download, protected local key storage and exact temporary-copy cleanup

credential_rotation_limit: Installation tokens expire after one hour; the GitHub App private key does not expire automatically. This is not a claim of automatic bootstrap-key rotation.

composition.configuration: Strict hash-pinned operator JSON (schema 1, at most 8 KiB): app client ID, installation ID, repository name/ID, absolute Git/OpenSSL/key paths, public-key fingerprint and attempt parent. No secrets; the digest is a local pin, not a signature
composition.sequence: Exclusive attempt directory and STARTED receipt -> fingerprint check -> one RS256 app JWT -> one scoped installation-token POST -> one exact-commit fetch -> content-digest check -> token revocation -> object cleanup
composition.no_retry: The issuer closure is single use; an attempt directory can never be reused; uncertain signing, issuance, fetch, revocation or cleanup stops as STOPPED_NEEDS_RECONCILIATION
composition.activation: enabled=True and owner_authorized=True are required; no entrypoint, schedule or workflow invokes it
